chapter.heading: For the music director. To be accompanied by stringed instruments. A psalm. A song.
chapter.v:
May God
be gracious to us and bless us. May he look favorably on us. Selah.

May everyone
on earth come to know your ways, your salvation among all people.

May the
people praise you, God; may all the people praise you.

May they
be happy and sing for joy because you judge people fairly, and you guide everyone on earth. Selah.

May the
people praise you, God; may all the people praise you.

The earth
has produced its crops; and God, our God, has blessed us.

God will
bless us, and all people everywhere will respect him.
